reviewer_notes: Existing kiosk (1080x1920 portrait, fixed layout, no scroll). js/i18n.js has a single flat STRINGS map hard-wired to English and a comment saying kiosks are English-only; the footer has a static EN badge. Correct change: turn STRINGS into per-locale maps (en + cy), add setLang/re-apply, and turn the footer badge into a real EN/CY toggle sized to --touch with a visible selected state and an accessible name. Welsh strings run ~25-35% longer than English, so buttons/labels must not overflow the fixed 1080px layout. Language should reset to EN on idle reset / Start over (shared device). Must not touch the idle timeout constant or the quantity stepper (concurrent tasks).
